# Analysis iChIP data, related to Fig.1
clusterprofiler results are changed when using different version of the library.
To reproduce the result treated in a manuscript, you need R4.4.3 and Bioinducgtor 3.20.
clusterProfiler 4.14.6 and org.Mm.eg.db 3.20.0 are required.

## 1. setup libraries
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Install BiocManager
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

#Install  Bioconductor 3.20
BiocManager::install(version = "3.20", ask = FALSE)
```

Before installing clusterProfiler, treeio and ggtree must be installed
```{r, eval=FALSE}
remotes::install_github("YuLab-SMU/treeio")
remotes::install_github("YuLab-SMU/ggtree")
```

Install clusterProfiler
```{r, eval=FALSE}
BiocManager::install(
    "clusterProfiler",
    version = "3.20",
    ask = FALSE,
    update = FALSE
)
```

Install org.Mm.eg.db
```{r, eval=FALSE}
BiocManager::install(
    "org.Mm.eg.db",
    version = "3.20",
    ask = FALSE,
    update = FALSE
)
```

Check versions
clusterProfiler should be 4.14.6.
org.Mm.eg.db should be 3.20.0
```{r}
packageVersion("clusterProfiler")
packageVersion("org.Mm.eg.db")
```

## 2. Read a iChIP data
```{r}
data <- read.csv("iChIP_input.csv", header=T, row.names=1)
```

## 3. draw heatmaps 
read the librararies
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
```

Draw heatmap for all
```{r}
# define top50 proteins
ave_top50 <- data[order(data$Ave, decreasing = TRUE), ][1:50, ]

ALL_heatmap <- data[,c("Exp.1","Exp.2")]
rownames(ALL_heatmap) <- data$Protein_Name

P1 <- pheatmap(ALL_heatmap,
         border_color = "white",
         cluster_cols = F,
         cluster_rows = F,
         clustering_distance_rows = "canberra",
         legend = T,
         color =  colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red2"))(100),
         breaks = c(seq(min(ALL_heatmap), 1, length.out = 51),
                    seq(1, max(ALL_heatmap), length.out = 50)[-1]),
         annotation_row = data.frame(Top50 = ifelse(rownames(ALL_heatmap) %in% ave_top50$Protein_Name, "Top50","Other"),
                                     row.names = rownames(ALL_heatmap)),
         show_rownames = F,
         cellwidth = 100
)
print(P1)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggsave("Fig1_heatmap_for_ALL.svg", plot = P1, width=8, height=10)
```


Draw heatmap for top 50 proteins
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)

top50_heatmap <- as.data.frame(ave_top50[,c("Exp.1","Exp.2")])
rownames(top50_heatmap) <- ave_top50$Protein_Name
P2 <- pheatmap(top50_heatmap,
         border = "white",
         cluster_cols = F,
         cluster_rows = F,
         clustering_distance_rows = "canberra",
         legend = T,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red2"))(100),
         breaks = c(seq(min(ALL_heatmap), 1, length.out = 51),
                    seq(1, max(ALL_heatmap), length.out = 50)[-1]),
         show_rownames = T
)
print(P2)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggsave("Fig1_heatmap_for_top50.svg", plot = P2, width=8, height=10)
```

## 4. Enrichment analysis
```{r}
# use gene symbols of top 50 prpteins
Top50_symbol <- as.character(row.names(ave_top50))
Top50_symbol
```
```{r}

```

Read libraries
```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
```

Do Enrichment analysis
```{r}
GO <- enrichGO(gene = Top50_symbol,
               OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
               keyType = "SYMBOL",
               ont = "ALL",
               pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
               qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
               
```

Sort the the result and check
```{r}
# use value for sort
GO@result <- GO@result[order(GO@result$qvalue), ]
head(GO@result)
```

Reduce redundancy 
```{r}
GO_simplified <- simplify(GO, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min)
head(GO_simplified@result)
```

Check the number of the results before and after of the simplifing
```{r}
nrow(GO@result)
nrow(GO_simplified@result)
```

Filter the result
```{r}
# FoldEnrichment > 15,GeneRatio > 5/50, qvalue < 0.05
GO_simplified_filtered_table <- GO_simplified@result[
  GO_simplified@result$FoldEnrichment > 15 &
  as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", GO_simplified@result$GeneRatio)) >= 5 &
  GO_simplified@result$qvalue < 0.05,
]
```

```{r}
length(row.names(GO_simplified_filtered_table))
GO_simplified_filtered_table
```

write the results
```{r. eval=FALSE}
write.csv(GO_simplified_filtered_table, "Fig1_enrich_GO_result.csv")
```


## 5. Draw dot plot
Survey results for GO terms passed the filter
```{r}
names_filtered <- GO_simplified_filtered_table$ID
GO_simplified_filtered <- GO_simplified


GO_simplified_filtered@result <- GO_simplified@result[GO_simplified@result$ID %in% names_filtered, ]
GO_simplified_filtered@result
```

for Dot plot, several terms were selected.
```{r}
GO_ID <- c("GO:0019843", "GO:0043021", "GO:1903312", "GO:0071013", "GO:0061980", "GO:0003727", "GO:0006403", "GO:0050658", "GO:0006334", "GO:0034728", "GO:0019674", "GO:0046496")
```

draw
```{r}
D <- dotplot(GO_simplified_filtered, showCategory = 30)
D$data <- D$data[D$data$ID %in% GO_ID, ]
D$data$Description <- factor(D$data$Description, levels = rev(D$data$Description[order(match(D$data$ID, GO_ID))]))
D <- D + aes(x = FoldEnrichment)
D
```

```{r}
D <- dotplot(GO_simplified_filtered, showCategory = 30)

D$data <- D$data[D$data$ID %in% GO_ID, ]

D$data$Description <- factor(
  D$data$Description,
  levels = rev(D$data$Description[order(match(D$data$ID, GO_ID))])
)

D <- D +
  aes(x = FoldEnrichment, fill = qvalue) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    name = "qvalue",
    trans = "reverse"

    
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = "black",
    guide = "none"
  )


print(D)
```
save
```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "Fig1_GSEA_dotplot.svg",
  plot = D,
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```


## 6. GSEA
In this section, GSEA was performed to check rank enrichments about the obserbed term on the above.

Read libraries
```{r}
library(stringr)
library(enrichplot)
```

Transfer fold change values into log2 scales.
```{r}
log2_ave <- log2(data$Ave)
names(log2_ave) <- row.names(data)
log2_ave_rank <- sort(log2_ave, decreasing = T)
```

Obtain GSEA database
```{r}
gmt <- read.gmt("https://data.broadinstitute.org/gsea-msigdb/msigdb/release/2025.1.Mm/m5.go.v2025.1.Mm.symbols.gmt")
```

Do GSEA
```{r}
#set random seed
set.seed(123)
Fig1_GSEA <- GSEA(log2_ave_rank,
                  TERM2GENE = gmt,
                  pvalueCutoff = 0.5)
```

Check the result
```{r}
head(Fig1_GSEA@result)
```

Search GO terms related rRNA
```{r}
grep("RRNA", Fig1_GSEA@result$Description, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
```


```{r}
pathways_rRNA <- c("GOBP_RRNA_PROCESSING", "GOMF_RRNA_BINDING")
```

Check the selected results
```{r}
Fig1_GSEA_rRNA <- Fig1_GSEA[
  Fig1_GSEA@result$ID %in% pathways_rRNA,
]
Fig1_GSEA_rRNA
```

Draw enrichment plots
```{r}
for (pathway in pathways_rRNA) {
  
  id <- which(Fig1_GSEA@result$ID == pathway)
  nes <- Fig1_GSEA@result$NES[id]
  qval <- Fig1_GSEA@result$qvalue[id]
  
  print(
    gseaplot2(Fig1_GSEA,
              id,
              color = "green",
              pvalue_table = FALSE,
              title = paste0(pathway, " \nNES = ", round(nes, 2), ", q = ", round(qval, 3)))
  )
              
}
```

Extract core enrichment genes
```{r}
core_enrichment_genes <- list()
core_enrichment_genes[["GOBP_RRNA_PROCESSING"]] <- strsplit(Fig1_GSEA@result$core_enrichment[Fig1_GSEA@result$ID == "GOBP_RRNA_PROCESSING"], "/")[[1]]
core_enrichment_genes[["GOMF_RRNA_BINDING"]] <- strsplit(Fig1_GSEA@result$core_enrichment[Fig1_GSEA@result$ID == "GOMF_RRNA_BINDING"], "/")[[1]]
core_enrichment_genes
```

```{r}
#geneList_log2からcore_enrichment_genesの値を確認
a <- log2_ave_rank[core_enrichment_genes[["GOBP_RRNA_PROCESSING"]]]
b <- log2_ave_rank[core_enrichment_genes[["GOMF_RRNA_BINDING"]]]
a
b
```

```{r}
#core_enrichment_genesについて、geneList_log2のindexを取得
index_data <- lapply(core_enrichment_genes, function(genes) {
  match(genes, names(log2_ave_rank))
})
index_data
```

```{r}
index_a <- match(core_enrichment_genes[["GOBP_RRNA_PROCESSING"]], names(log2_ave_rank))
index_b <- match(core_enrichment_genes[["GOMF_RRNA_BINDING"]], names(log2_ave_rank))
index_a
index_b
```

export the results of GSEA
```{r, eval=FALSE}
sink("261005_GSEA_core_enrichment_genes.txt")

cat("GOBP_RRNA_PROCESSING:\n")
cat("Index\tGene\tValue\n")
write.table(data.frame(Index = index_a, Gene = names(a), Value = a), row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")

cat("\nGOMF_RRNA_BINDING:\n")
cat("Index\tGene\tValue\n")
write.table(data.frame(Index = index_b, Gene = names(b), Value = b), row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")

sink()
```
